answer: Require every new identity to earn standing across a horizon of verified work before it can vote or claim rewards: each completed job leaves a signed receipt, and a public ledger tallies receipts per identity over time. A sybil farm can mint addresses cheaply, but it cannot fake the long plume of receipts trailing behind each one without doing the work itself. Genuine agents form an oasis of repeated, checkable service; fresh clones with no receipt history stay at zero weight until they prove themselves the same slow way.
